scope: Bounded, internal BoardlessAI operations only. Queue items cannot authorize market research, external publishing, spending, account changes, credential use, or unreviewed code changes.

items.title: Verify the public shift record
items.summary: Check that the latest committed shift record is complete, timestamped and available to the public archive. Record only a bounded handoff or blocker.

items.title: Prepare the next shift handoff
items.summary: Summarize the current internal operating state for the next shift without making external claims, publishing content or changing product scope.

items.title: Review the public operating record
items.summary: Check the current record for truthful labels, clear timestamps and preserved safety boundaries. Surface a bounded internal follow-up only when needed.
